nodes.label: Native <select> Chosen Over shadcn/ui Select
nodes.rationale: shadcn's Radix-based Select rejects empty-string item values needed for the 'Toutes les X' placeholder options; native <select>/<button> elements with Tailwind classes are used instead, since a workaround wasn't worth it for a single dropdown.

nodes.label: Manual Export + Commit Persistence for Métiers Assignations
nodes.rationale: metiers_assignations.json is versioned in the repo like the CSV, edited via an 'Exporter' UI action that copies/downloads the updated JSON for the user to commit manually — no write backend is implemented.
nodes.norm_label: manual export + commit persistence for metiers assignations

nodes.label: Real URL Routes via React Router (not internal tab state)
nodes.rationale: Navigation uses real URL routes (/, /classes, /roster, /metiers, /builds) via React Router rather than tabs driven by internal component state.
nodes.norm_label: real url routes via react router (not internal tab state)

nodes.label: Context-only State Management (no Zustand/React Query)
nodes.rationale: React hooks + Context are used for state/data instead of an external state library; Zustand/React Query were judged overkill for this data volume.

nodes.label: Apache Airflow Option Abandoned for GitHub Actions
nodes.rationale: Local Airflow via Docker was developed as an alternative orchestration but abandoned because it requires a permanently-on machine and a Docker stack to operate, whereas GitHub Actions eliminates client-side infrastructure entirely.
nodes.norm_label: apache airflow option abandoned for github actions

nodes.label: Runtime Data Fetch Pattern (never bundled)
nodes.rationale: Dashboard reads mon_dataset_wow.csv and reference JSON files via fetch() from the raw GitHub URL at runtime, never from the Vite build output, so the daily CSV update requires no redeploy.

nodes.label: [skip ci] CI Decoupling Pattern
nodes.rationale: The daily CSV commit made by main.yml carries the [skip ci] message tag so it does not retrigger the deploy.yml build/deploy workflow, consistent with the dashboard fetching CSV/JSON at runtime rather than at build time.
